_note: Release contract (T0.6). release.yml publishes `release.version` once: when CI is green on main and the tag v<version> does not exist yet, and only if app/build.gradle carries the same versionName/versionCode. null = nothing to release. Asset names end with the version (owner, 2026-10-12): `{version}` in `assets` is the app versionName; README links to the releases/latest page. `fully_tested: false` adds the 'not fully tested yet' line to the notes (INBOX #3: intermediate releases before the one full test pass).

release.notes_extra:
Fixes the owner's crash (Samsung S25 Ultra, Android 17): the phone froze for about a minute and its system screen restarted, because the app's download service restarted itself in a loop (4,105 starts in 80 s) whenever Android refused it. The service now never restarts itself, stops quietly when Android says no, and runs only while a download or a VidChain rescue needs it. Also faster social links, faster large downloads, VidChain's methods starting beside a download that gets no data, per-method switches instead of the master switch, and nothing running in the background when idle. Full list: CHANGELOG.md.

| Measured on the Android 11 test phone | 1.1.5 | 1.2.0 |
|---|---|---|
| Cold start | 1,916 ms | 1,927 ms |
| X link: share to picker / download | 2.8 s / 13.5 s | 1.5 s / 7.9 s |
| Instagram link: share to picker / download | 2.5 s / 47 s | 1.5 s / 7.3 s |
| 94 MB file download (same network, interleaved) | 29 s (before stage 5) | 11-13 s |
| CPU while idle, per 10 min | 10.5 s, service always on | 0.5 s, no service |
| A download with no data moves on after | 5 min | 75 s |
| Download service starts when Android refuses it | endless loop | at most 1 per 10 s, none while idle |

methods_per_abi._note: Fallback methods per ABI (Q8 = A: new natives on 64-bit only). CI and release.yml check every APK against this with tools/release/method_matrix.py; the universal APK carries each ABI's set.

method_natives._note: native libraries a method runs in lib/<abi>/ (S, W and H hand media streams to yt-dlp; ffmpeg merges and remuxes); methods not listed run on every ABI (Java/Kotlin or WebView)
